assembly_limits.nominal_source_frame: A seven-part header on p212, numbered 1/2/4/5 there and 6/7 on p213. The intervening 224-coordinate block lacks an explicit part 3 label.
assembly_limits.qualification: Numbering and the medical theme connect the readable medical passages, but the complete seven-part message is not reconstructed. The interposed oil query is not presented as medical content.

prior_attribution_check.scope: Bounded check of explicit body discussion, not a claim that no earlier researcher ever read these messages.

earlier_repository_candidates.interpretation: The oil query, hospital-wagon instruction and final medical paragraph were already recognizable in unreviewed OCR screens. The edition adds exact source frames, conditional first-part restoration, priced corrections and explicitly unresolved fragments. No first historical decipherment claim is made.
